summary: INX Limited, a Gibraltar-based finance services firm, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, reporting its cumulative Adjusted Operating Cash Flow as of June 30, 2026, and the indicative pro rata Distributable Amount per INX Token of $0.24145. The filing notes that on November 10, 2025, the company was acquired by OpenDeal Inc. (d/b/a Republic), which triggered a cash distribution event under the INX Token purchase agreement. As of June 30, 2026, $2,846 remains unclaimed. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of token contractual distributions, not a special-situation transaction. No new deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are announced. Watch for future 6-Ks on distribution completion.
